svg.text: Icon set mixes canvases, strokes and fills
Real assets from crates/ui/assets/icons, drawn at 32 px (2× of the common 16 px size)
Solar Linear (24 px canvas, 1.5 stroke → 1.0 px at 16)
Hand-drawn / ported / other weights (rendered px at 16 pt)
≈47 of 112 glyphs hand-drawn or ported + 4 mirrored copies; only ≈57 fetched from Solar
close/plus render 25% heavier than neighbours; check 60% heavier; pause 33% heavier
‘embedded set has no …’ → glyphs hand-drawn instead of fetched (info, chevron-up, pin, play …)
